title: Indian Cattle Breed Practical Data Dataset
description: Practical breed-level reference data for an animal breed identification application.
important_note: Body weight, lifespan, feed intake and milk yield vary by sex, age, genetics, pregnancy/lactation stage, nutrition, climate and management. Values below are indicative ranges for adult animals and should not be treated as veterinary, ration-formulation or breeding advice.
feed_method: Approximate daily dry-matter intake (DMI) is derived from adult female body-weight ranges using a broad cattle guideline of about 2.0% BW/day for maintenance and about 2.5-3.0% BW/day for lactating animals. Actual rations must be formulated from forage quality, milk yield, physiological stage and veterinary/nutrition advice.
